name: spi_target
description: SPI target, mode 0, no chip select: pin 0 is SCLK (uio5), pin 1 is MOSI (uio6), output 2 is MISO (uo[0] while the host opcode is 7). shifter0 samples on SCLK rises and shifts its reply out after each rise; the lane supplies replies from the source stream and stores received bytes.

word_notes.4: only output 2 enabled, push-pull; pin 0 (SCLK) edges on rise
word_notes.68: pins 0 and 1 read their own pads
